summary: Frontend-only re-test of Pain Map new features: unregistered-email register handoff, admin login, nav avatar dropdown, Profile page (edit/save/persistence/avatar), named testimonials, and sign-out. All 12 critical flows passed on desktop (1920x1080).
critical_code_review_comments: Profile.js: initials fallback uses only first char; works but if user has blank name & email it would render '?'. Minor.
Login.js: 404 branch assumes error.response exists; if network error occurs (no response), formatApiError is called on undefined - acceptable but could guard.
Profile avatar: existing user picture (Google) prevents testing of initials fallback via data-testid='profile-avatar-initials' for this admin account (img shown instead). Not a bug.
seed_data_creation: None. Profile phone/age/blood-type edited on admin account (B+, +91 99999 09010, age 41) - persisted via PATCH /api/auth/profile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 requested flows verified: (1) unregistered email -> login-go-register-btn appears & prefills email on /register, (2) admin login -> /dashboard, (3) nav-user-menu-btn dropdown shows nav-profile-btn + nav-logout-btn, (4) /profile shows email & editable fields, (5) edit blood/phone/age + Save shows toast & persists after reload, (6) avatar upload button present (admin has Google picture so img shown instead of initials), (7) /reviews shows all four named testimonials (Aishwarya Taneja, Rajvir Saini, S. P. Yadav, Tenzin Rawat) with 5 images, (8) sign out returns to home & shows Login link. 401 console errors on /login are expected unauth /api/auth/me probes.
